controls._searchLabel: Search (program / PID / remote IP / remote port):
controls._safetyNoticeLabel: Manages only its own WFP filters in a dedicated sublayer; never changes Windows Firewall settings. Optional network lookups can be disabled.
controls._rulesNoticeLabel: Blocked programs cannot appear on the Connections page — they cannot connect, so they have no connections. To restore access, delete the matching rule here (IP blocks are listed here too, marked in the Type column).
controls._whitelistNoticeLabel: This whitelist only applies in strict mode: while strict mode is on, only the programs listed here (plus required system programs) can reach the network. When strict mode is off, these rules restrict nothing.
controls._settingsNoticeLabel: Auto-start creates a Task Scheduler task named WinAppGuard that launches the app at logon with highest privileges, so no UAC prompt appears. This is the only persistent system setting; disable it below or delete the task in taskschd.msc.
controls._privacyLabel:
Three features can use the network, and all can be turned off:
· IP ownership lookup (on by default, switchable here): sends the remote IP to whois.cymru.com. Only the remote IP is sent — no process name, path or port; LAN and local addresses are filtered out.
· Certificate revocation check (on by default, switchable here): Windows' certificate service queries the CA on behalf of the app.
· Domain guessing (on by default, switchable on Records): reads the local DNS cache. If an entry has expired, Windows may send one lookup; turn it off to send no packets at all.
With all three off, the app makes no network traffic. Logs stay on this machine in the folder below and are never uploaded:
controls._checkRevocationCheckBox: Check certificate revocation (queries the CA online; uncheck for zero network traffic)
controls._checkIpOwnershipCheckBox: Look up IP ownership (sends the remote IP to whois.cymru.com; uncheck to send nothing)
